_description: The 480 thumn positions of the Qālūn muṣḥaf, assembled and checked: each juz holds exactly 16, and the total is 480. Every one of the 479 markable positions was also matched, by page and line, to its label in the outer margin of the KFGQPC 1440 AH Qālūn print (qaloun-1.pdf, SHA-256 57386a90…06cc) and of the 1443 AH digital muṣḥaf (1443-qalon.zip, SHA-256 08ebd0b0…f2da), which agree line for line. Not yet a published layer — data/ carries no thumn_starts — this file records the evidence so the work does not have to be done from the print again. `number` is the shared word number; `ayah` and `page` are this edition's.

_sources.division_mark: a ۞ printed in the text of UthmanicQaloun-v-3.0.docx; the one it prints at 39:51 is not used (docs/known-issues.md §7)
_sources.juz_start: a juz start from QalounData_v2-1.csv; see docs/known-issues.md §11 for the two this file does not use
_sources.surah_opening_by_count: a sūrah opening in a juz holding fewer than 16, where the count leaves no other candidate
_sources.margin_label: read from a printed muṣḥaf: «حزب», «ربع», «نصف» or «ثمن» in the outer margin, beside the line holding the division. The five mid-sūrah ones also carry an inline ۞ in the print that the docx lacks or puts an āyah late (docs/known-issues.md §7)

_caution: The print labels every thumn, in the order «حزب»، «ثمن»، «ربع»، «ثمن»، «نصف»، «ثمن»، «ربع»، «ثمن»: the third quarter reads «ربع», not «ثلاثة أرباع», and no label carries a ḥizb number, so `hizb` is counted, not read. At a sūrah opening the label stands beside the first āyah, below the basmalah, not beside the heading.
